high_level_description: The image is a collage that juxtaposes two sets of photographs, labeled "The real life Peaky Blinders (1910)" at the top. The top half of the image shows four sepia-toned photographs of men dressed in early 20th-century attire, likely from the year 1910. They are wearing flat caps, which were popular during that era, and their clothing includes suits, waistcoats, and ties. The men appear to be posing for formal portraits, with some having their hands clasped in front of them. The bottom half of the image features four colorized photographs of actors
